name: Group or chat roster
summary: The names (and avatars) of the specific people a game is for: a Group's members, a chat's members or a friend list, handed to the game as content so rules and text can name them.
when_to_use: Games about or between specific people: guess who said it, whose photo, story circles, superlatives, team totals that list each member.
api: planned: game content gets members [{id, name}] from the play target; the server data exists at GET /v1/groups/{id} (members) and GET /v1/me/friends
gaps_it_closes: games can name people only through single params (turns p1-p4, beat_target friend_name, shared_progress group_name)
notes: today: up to 4 names via the turns fragment's p1-p4 params, one friend via beat_target and ghost_score params, the Group name via shared_progress

name: Friend vote tally
summary: Friends or a Group's members vote on entries (drawings, captions, beats, predictions), and the server tallies the votes into a winner and per-entry counts.
when_to_use: Creative and party games judged by people instead of rules: best drawing, funniest caption, better beat, playlist picks.
api: planned: POST a vote {gameId, entryId}; GET tallies per entry; one vote per person per round
gaps_it_closes: no way to judge a run by other people; scores come only from the game's own rules
notes: needs a backend endpoint; not in backend/README.md. Inside one phone, approximate with turns plus a tap-to-vote screen

name: Anonymous submissions
summary: Each member privately submits an answer, quote, caption or clip; the pool is shown without names so others can guess or vote, and authors are revealed at the end.
when_to_use: Whose-answer, who-said-it, bluffing (fake answers) and caption games built from what the players themselves write.
api: planned: POST a submission {gameId, round, text}; GET the round's pool without author ids, then with them after the reveal
gaps_it_closes: games can't use content written by the players themselves
notes: related app flow: Make it together (docs/BUBBLES.md 7.4) gathers friends' contributions before Muse makes the game, with canned demo content; there is no server store

name: Friend pairing
summary: Pairs two specific friends on one game over time: both sides' moves, drawings or answers are stored and shown to the other, so a duo can play back and forth.
when_to_use: Two-person async games: draw-and-guess with a friend, mind-meld word matching, compatibility quizzes, beat battles.
api: planned: create a pair {gameId, friendId}; post my turn; get the friend's latest turn
gaps_it_closes: friend play today is score-only (score_challenge, ghost_score)
notes: close to async_turns; score_challenge covers the score-only case today

name: Live room
summary: A live room where several phones play the same game at once with shared state (a host's quiz with buzzers, a shared jam).
when_to_use: Live classroom quizzes, live jams, real-time party games.
notes: same gap as live_multiplayer. Approximate with game night (everyone plays the same seed and a podium compares) or turns on one phone

name: Resolve later
summary: Stores predictions or bets now and settles them later, when the outcome is known or a date passes, then notifies the players with the scores.
when_to_use: Predict-what-a-friend-will-do games, weekly bets, guesses that settle after an event.
api: planned: POST a prediction {gameId, question, pick, resolvesAt}; resolution posted by a member or at the date
gaps_it_closes: every run ends and scores within one session

name: Creation gallery
summary: Keeps what a player made in a run (a drawing, a room, a beat, a garden) and shows it to friends or a Group as a picture or a replay they can watch.
when_to_use: Creative, cozy and music-making games whose output is the point: share the result, browse friends' creations.
api: planned: store the run's replay (input log) and a poster frame; list a Group's or friend's creations
gaps_it_closes: results share only a headline and score text, not what was made
notes: runs already produce a replay (input log) and the runtime can draw a poster frame or play a replay (docs/BUBBLES.md 4.3), so a gallery can re-render creations; storing and listing them is what's missing

name: Photo picker
summary: Lets players add their own photos (from the camera roll or a Group's posts) as game content, for guessing, captions or puzzles.
when_to_use: Whose-photo, where-was-this-taken, caption contests and personal photo puzzles.
gaps_it_closes: games can show only generated art, not people's own photos
notes: the engine draws image assets, but there is no path from a person's photos into a game's assets, and that also needs a privacy review

name: Camera capture
summary: Takes a photo with the phone camera during a run, as an answer or entry.
when_to_use: Photo scavenger hunts and take-a-picture-of challenges.

name: Send a game into a chat or Group
summary: Sends a game into a chat thread or a Group as a round: everyone plays the same seed and length on their own turn, whenever they like, and each finished run posts its result line back to the same thread.
when_to_use: Every game is played this way; the plan's social.mode says what a send starts. Games need a fair shared seed, a 30-90 s round and one result line (social.share_line).
api: planned: POST /v1/rounds {gameId, target: {kind: chat|group, id}, mode, bestOf?} -> {round: {id, seed, length, members, plays}}; POST /v1/rounds/{id}/plays {log}; GET /v1/rounds/{id}

params.mode: same_seed_async | series | group_round | weekly_board | opinion_compare (the manifest's group_play.mode)

notes: Shipped pieces: 1:1 'beat my score' (score_challenge), friend series (series_best_of), the Group weekly board (weekly_group_board). Missing: a round tied to a chat thread with many members, and results posted back to it. docs/harness-gaps/group-play.md has the request for Max.

name: Best-of series with a friend
summary: A best-of-N (1-5 rounds) between two friends on server-picked seeds; each run is replayed in the engine and the server keeps the replayed score, decides each round and the series.
when_to_use: Skill games two friends replay to settle who's better: racing, reaction, sports, arcade. The plan's social.mode series with best_of 3 or 5.
notes: Two players only. A round goes to the higher score today, so a lower-is-better score (time_to_complete) needs the score model's direction on the server (Max).

name: Group weekly board
summary: A Group's members ranked across the Group's games for an ISO week by rank points (10, 7, 5, 3, 2, then 1), with rank change from last week.
when_to_use: Group dailies and any ranked game made for a Group: the plan's social.mode weekly_board.

name: Group round
summary: Everyone in a group chat or Group plays the same seed and length; the round ranks every member who played by the score model (or the ending, or agreement) and names the winner when the round closes.
when_to_use: Quiz, word and daily games for a whole chat or Group: the plan's social.mode group_round.
api: planned: the chat_round API with mode group_round; closes when everyone has played or after closesAt
notes: The app's sessions and game nights do this locally today (docs/BUBBLES.md 7.2, 7.7); the server has only per-game scoped boards.

name: Agreement with the group
summary: For games with no right answer (ratings, tier lists, rankings, this-or-that): keeps each player's picks from the replay, and returns how closely they agree with a friend, with the chat or Group, and with everyone, plus the group's pick per item.
when_to_use: Opinion games: the plan's social.result.compare agreement and mode opinion_compare. The score stays unranked.
api: planned: POST /v1/games/{id}/picks {log} (picks read from the replay's end state, group_play.result.state); GET /v1/games/{id}/agreement?with=<userId>|scope=friends|group&groupId= -> {agreement: 0-100, items: [{item, mine, group, share}]}

params.state: the game state that holds the picks (group_play.result.state)

gaps_it_closes: opinion games can't compare with everyone
notes: Stand-in until it ships: two friends in a chat compare picks side by side (authoring/expander/group-play.mjs agreement), and the game reveals no group average it doesn't have.

name: Run result from the replay
summary: The engine's verify reports the end values of the game state named in the manifest's group_play.result.state (the ending reached, choices used, the picks), so the server can compare runs by more than the score.
when_to_use: Story games compared by ending, and opinion games compared by picks.
api: planned: MicrogameEngine.verify(game, log) -> {..., result: {<state name>: value}}
notes: Today verify returns phase, time and score only. Request for Artem in docs/harness-gaps/group-play.md.

name: Everyone's answers, tallied
summary: The server tallies every player's answer or pick per prompt (from verified replays) and returns the shares, so a game can show "62% picked the same" or reward the most or least popular answer.
when_to_use: Polls, opinion games, survey-style or Family Feud-style rounds, rarity scored from real players instead of a fixed answer bank.
api: planned: POST /v1/games/{id}/picks {log} (picks from the replay's end state); GET /v1/games/{id}/tally?prompt=&scope=everyone|friends|group -> {items: [{answer, share}]}
gaps_it_closes: games can't compare a player's answer with everyone's
notes: The same request as opinion_aggregate (docs/harness-gaps/group-play.md, Max). Until then: compare picks between two friends, and never invent a group average. Kevin32 #18.

name: Free-text questions answered live
aliases: ask questions in my own words
summary: The player types any question in their own words and gets an answer from a model while playing.
when_to_use: Interrogations, lateral-thinking puzzles and character chats where the questions can't be listed ahead of time.
gaps_it_closes: typed questions get answers only from a build-time bank
notes: No Muse while someone plays (replays must verify). Approximate with qa_bank: typed yes/no questions matched against a build-time fact bank (docs/harness-gaps/open-text.md). Kevin32 #26.

name: Saved progress across runs
summary: Keeps a player's progress between runs and days (unlocks, levels, a collection, stats) on the server, so the next run starts where the last one ended.
when_to_use: RPGs, idle games, collections and pets whose point is growing over many sessions.
api: planned: GET/PUT /v1/games/{id}/save (a small JSON state, versioned with the game); the run reads it as a param
notes: Replays stay verifiable if the save is an input to the run (recorded in the log). Until then: checkpoint within a run, and next_level makes a new game per stage. Kevin32 S3.
